purpose: CMF board — three colorway variants: Creative Coral, Ocean Depth, Dream Lab
prompt: CMF (Color Material Finish) presentation board showing three colorway variants of 'VibeFlow' compact input device. Clean board layout on warm neutral background #F2EDE8. Title 'CMF Options' in geometric sans-serif bold at top. Three columns, each containing: a 3/4 angle device thumbnail at top, a row of 5 color swatch circles below, and material notes in medium weight text. Column 1 'Creative Coral': coral #E8735A shell + amber #F5A623 knob + surface #F2EDE8 keycaps + graphite #4A464D sides + ink #2D2A2E accents, labeled 'Matte shell + Gloss knob + Semi-transparent touch zone'. Column 2 'Ocean Depth': teal #2A7B88 shell + gloss-white #FAFAF7 knob + surface #F2EDE8 keycaps + graphite #4A464D sides + ink #2D2A2E accents, labeled 'Cool matte finish + Polished knob'. Column 3 'Dream Lab': lavender #B8A9D4 shell + coral #E8735A knob + graphite #4A464D keycaps + surface #F2EDE8 accents + ink #2D2A2E text, labeled 'Soft-touch coating + Contrast accent'. All devices maintain identical 65% layout geometry with 12mm rounded corners. Subtle flow-curves motif as decorative divider between columns.
negative_prompt: dark background, gaming aesthetics, RGB lighting, cluttered layout, no text labels, pure white background, pure black background, messy arrangement
